name: LED Light Bulb
blurb: A standard 60-watt-equivalent LED draws about 9 watts — lighting an entire room for less than a penny an hour. A whole house converted to LED typically spends less on lighting in a month than one incandescent bulb used to.

name: Incandescent Bulb
blurb: Classic incandescent bulbs turn about 90% of their electricity into heat, not light. Each one you replace with an LED cuts that fixture's cost by roughly 85% — one of the only home upgrades with a payback measured in months.

name: CFL Bulb
blurb: CFLs cut incandescent costs by about 75%, but modern LEDs beat them on power, lifespan, instant-on, and dimming. There's no reason to buy new CFLs — replace them with LEDs as they burn out.

name: LED Light Strip
blurb: Accent light strips draw roughly 2–5 watts per meter at full brightness, so a typical setup runs 10–40 watts. Colors and dimming drop that further — ambiance is cheap.

name: Fluorescent Tube Fixture
blurb: A two-tube T8 shop fixture draws about 70 watts including ballast losses. LED tube retrofits halve that and eliminate ballast failures — worthwhile in any garage or basement lit for hours daily.

name: Grow Light
blurb: Grow lights run long photoperiods — commonly 12–18 hours daily — so even efficient LED panels rack up serious kilowatt-hours. A single 300-watt light on a 14-hour schedule uses more electricity than most refrigerators; indoor growing budgets should start with the electric bill.
tips: Buy by PPF efficiency (µmol/J), not wattage — modern LED bars deliver the same light for 40% less power than old HPS.
Use a timer religiously; every extra lit hour is pure cost.
Reflective surfaces let you run lights lower or farther for the same canopy light.

name: Outdoor Flood Light
blurb: LED flood lights draw 15–50 watts versus 150+ for old halogens, and dusk-to-dawn operation means long hours. Motion sensors typically cut runtime — and cost — by 80% or more.

name: Christmas Lights
blurb: A modern all-LED holiday display often draws under 100 watts total, while the same footage of old incandescent strings can pull ten times that. December's light bill is almost entirely a question of which decade your lights were made in.

name: Halogen Torchiere Lamp
blurb: Halogen torchieres draw 150–500 watts — one lamp can out-consume every LED in the house combined. LED torchiere replacements produce the same light for about a tenth the power.

name: Night Light
blurb: LED night lights draw well under a watt; even a houseful running dusk to dawn costs a dollar or two per year. Old incandescent 4–7 watt models are the only versions worth replacing.

name: Landscape Lighting
blurb: A low-voltage LED landscape system typically totals 20–100 watts across all fixtures on a dusk timer. Solar path lights bring marginal cost to zero, at the price of dimmer, less consistent light.
